analysis.narrativeEn:

· Below SMA100 ($0.19)/SMA200 ($0.22) — Mid-to-long term trend is weak
· 52-week position (5.8%) + Current price level is slightly above the 52-week low ($0.14)
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (48.7→54.1) + Exiting oversold, entering neutral zone
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.0014→-0.0019) + Continues to worsen, maintaining bearish signal
· Bollinger Band current price position (Middle Band $0.19) + Bandwidth at 21% indicates moderate volatility
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($0.16) + Aligns with Pivot S1, matches 5-day low
· Swing resistance ($0.19) + Aligns with Pivot PP, matches SMA20/SMA100
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Consolidation) + Lack of directional trend
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (3.13x 5-day average) + Increased confidence in price movement
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation) + Waiting for confirmation of breakout above the $0.17-$0.19 range
